2105-4598-7060-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-4598-7060-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-4598-7060-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Essence Flux from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1981-2415-3845-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on them.
Repeat.
1981-2415-3845-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

553-8035.description:
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Divide by Zero by paying its mana cost, returning Approach of the Second Sun to your hand.
Cast Approach of the Second Sun by paying its mana cost, causing you to win the game.

275-5078-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
275-5078-7010.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Gran-Gran.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Transplant Theorist triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Transplant Theorist trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

215-4460-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven creatures with different powers.
215-4460-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-4460-5457.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {W}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Selvala

2921-4446-4681-5170.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2921-4446-4681-5170.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

647-2366-2800-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
647-2366-2800-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

967-2921-3809-4772-7087.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3334-5902-6575--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent and Lae'zel, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2932-4050-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2932-4050-5220-6900.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.

2932-4050-5220-6900.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

1921-2034-4894.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Breaching Hippocamp token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Breaching Hippocamp token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Breaching Hippocamp token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Breaching Hippocamp token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

1652-5060-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-5060-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

4484-4871-5256-5643-6710.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-5256-5643-6710.notablePrerequisites: There are two cards exiled by The Kenriths' Royal Funeral.
4484-4871-5256-5643-6710.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5256-5643-6710.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

224-225-1772-5621.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Arid Archway.
Activate Arid Archway by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
224-225-1772-5621.notes: You can untap any land using Stone-Seeder Hierophant's ability if you wish to gain other color(s) and/or type(s) of mana, or use other abilities once you have infinite mana.

1661-4050-5043-5078.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Coercive Recruiter
2440-2534-4183-5115.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter with haste.
When the token Coercive Recruiter enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Coercive Recruiter trigger, untapping Saheeli.

Activate Gemstone Array's second ability twice by removing two charge counters from it, adding {U}{R}.

101-372-2955.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
101-372-2955.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Vampire Charmseeker and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Vampire Charmseeker trigger.
Resolve the Vampire Charmseeker trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Vampire Charmseeker and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

275-751-3390-6075.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn.
You have no other cards in your library with a mana value of 0.

Shrieking Drake's cascade ability from Abaddon the Despoiler triggers, causing you to cast Lotus Bloom from your library since it is the only valid card to cast.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering itself, returning itself to your hand.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Transplant Theorist by paying {2}, putting Lotus Bloom from your graveyard on the bottom of your library.
Repeat.

4013-4384-4659.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Treebeard.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Foods, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
4013-4384-4659.notes: Once you have infinite Foods, you may instead sacrifice them to their own abilities.

Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.

Resolve the Black Carriage ability, untapping it.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car to the battlefield from your graveyard.

147-2171-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a nonlegendary creature card in your graveyard.

Cast Persist by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Persist.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Persist, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Persist copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.

Activate the Chromatic Orrery copies first abilities by tapping them, adding {10}.

Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens' second abilities to draw infinite cards.

3866-4050-4499.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to black is at least four.

Abhorrent Overlord enters the battlefield, creating a number of 1/1 Harpy creature tokens equal to your devotion to black.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Harpys, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1912-2034-4385.description:
Activate Sliver Queen by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Sliver token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

654-880-4862.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
654-880-4862.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control.
If the creature was an Elemental, Omnath triggers, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Omnath and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping the land.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
